736:     const continuation =
737:       subAgentContinuation === undefined
738:         ? undefined
739:         : parseSubAgentContinuation(subAgentContinuation, parentSessionId);
740:     if (subAgentContinuation !== undefined && !continuation) {
741:       throw new SessionError("Invalid sub-agent continuation metadata or parent ownership");
742:     }
743:     const sessionId = explicitSessionId ?? nanoid(16);
744:     const state: SessionState = {
745:       sessionId,
746:       kind,
747:       stateRevision: 0,
748:       cwd,
749:       workspace: { root: cwd, kind: "main" },
750:       startedAt: Date.now(),
751:       model,
752:       provider,
753:       tokenUsage: { promptTokens: 0, completionTokens: 0, totalTokens: 0 },
754:       cacheUsageVersion: 1,
755:       cumulativePromptTokens: 0,
756:       cumulativeCacheReadTokens: 0,
757:       cumulativeCacheCreationTokens: 0,
758:       turnCount: 0,
759:       invokedSkills: [],
760:       status: "active",
761:       // Always write the key: a sub-agent gets its parent sid; a top-level
762:       // session gets explicit null. This lets the desktop disk-rebuild tell a
763:       // new top-level session (key present, null) apart from a legacy session
764:       // (key absent) and from a sub-agent (key present, non-empty string).
765:       parentSessionId: parentSessionId ?? null,
766:       ...(continuation ? { subAgentContinuation: continuation } : {}),
767:       ...(ephemeral || sessionId.startsWith("qchat-") ? { ephemeral: true } : {}),
768:       ...(origin ? { origin } : {}),
769:     };

195:     // Cold start: shape (2) reuses the host-supplied sid; shape (3)
